PreToolUse.command: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if ! git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only); if [ -z "$CHANGED" ]; then exit 0; fi; NEED_CORE=0; NEED_API=0; NEED_WEB=0; NEED_FINETUNE=0; echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^core/.*\.py$" && NEED_CORE=1 || true; echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^api/src/.*\.ts$" && NEED_API=1 || true; echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^web/src/.*\.(ts|tsx)$" && NEED_WEB=1 || true; echo "$CHANGED" | grep -Eq "^(finetune/|core/mascarade/finetune/)" && NEED_FINETUNE=1 || true; if [ "$NEED_CORE" -eq 1 ] && [ -x core/.venv/bin/python ]; then (cd core && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_router.py -q >/dev/null); fi; if [ "$NEED_API" -eq 1 ] && [ -d api/node_modules ]; then (cd api && npm run -s build >/dev/null); fi; if [ "$NEED_WEB" -eq 1 ] && [ -d web/node_modules ]; then (cd web && npm run -s build >/dev/null); fi; if [ "$NEED_FINETUNE" -eq 1 ] && [ -x core/.venv/bin/python ]; then (cd core && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_finetune.py -q >/dev/null); fi'
